Overview.Name: Soundarya Kollimarla
Overview.Goal: Support fat loss, balance hormones, improve energy and reduce PCOS symptoms with simple, whole-ingredient vegetarian meals for appearance, energy, health improvement, and mental wellbeing.

Meal_1_Morning: 3 whole eggs pan fried in ghee + a bowl of cooked vegetables
OR Paneer (150g) pan fried in butter + vegetables
OR Curd bowl + 2 boiled eggs + fruit
OR Paneer bhurji cooked in ghee + small portion rice
Optional add-ons: Fruit (apple, papaya or banana) OR Curd with pepper
Meal_2_Midday_Lunch: OR 3 boiled or pan fried eggs + vegetables + small portion rice
OR Paneer cooked in butter + rice
Meal_3_Evening_Dinner: OR Paneer cooked in ghee + vegetables
OR Curd + cooked vegetables + 1 boiled egg
Snack_Optional_Light: OR Small bowl of curd with salt and pepper
OR Buttermilk (no store-bought masala, no seed oils)

Notes_and_Tips: For PCOS & Thyroid: Keep meals protein-heavy to support hormones and reduce cravings.
Avoid long gaps between meals; stick to your 3-meal structure for hormone balance.
Reduce sugar and deep-fried foods since cravings already lean towards sweet, fried, spicy.
For stress, late nights, boredom eating: Keep boiled eggs, paneer cubes and fruit ready for clean food choices.
Drink a glass of water when cravings hit. Wait 10 minutes before eating.
Avoid eating while watching TV or scrolling to prevent mindless overeating.
For sleep & energy: Aim for small improvements, sleep 20 minutes earlier each week.
Keep dinner lighter to avoid late-night discomfort and improve sleep quality.
Protein-heavy meals tighten physique and reduce bloating for appearance goals.
Stay consistent with steps and yoga for steady inch loss and hormone balance.
Walk 10 minutes after meals to improve digestion and metabolism.
Use ghee or butter only for cooking. Avoid all seed oils for PCOS management.
